_comment: Per-block brand override manifest. cssOverrides: block -> [brands] that ship blocks/<brand>/<block>.css (loaded AFTER base CSS so it wins the cascade). jsOverrides: block -> [brands] that ship blocks/<brand>/<block>.js, which REPLACES the base decorator (the base blocks/<block>/<block>.js is NOT run for that brand). loadBlock() only loads an override when listed here, so absent files never 404. Tokens + styles/brands/<brand>.css are the default for styling; per-block CSS/JS overrides are escape hatches for structural divergence in complex blocks (header, footer, isi, hero). Example: { "cssOverrides": { "hero-pharma": ["skyrizi"] }, "jsOverrides": { "header": ["skyrizi"] } }.
